title: Direction-Conditioned Policies via Compositional Subgoal Scoring for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.16515v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman theory implies that the optimal goal-conditioned action depends on the goal only through the gradient of the goal-reaching distance at the current state, yet standard online GCRL still conditions the actor on the raw goal -- a signal that is geometrically uninformative when the goal is far from the data distribution. We propose Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a fully online method that decomposes goal-reaching into two components sharing one InfoNCE representation $\psi$: a subgoal-scoring step that selects a visited state $z_t$ aligned with the final goal $g$ in $\psi_g$, and a direction-conditioned actor that consumes the unit direction $d_t$ and magnitude $r_t$ from $\psi(s_t)$ to $\psi(z_t)$. translated_title: 通过组合式子目标评分实现方向条件化策略的在线目标条件强化学习
translated_abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman理论表明，最优的目标条件动作仅通过当前状态下到达目标的距离梯度来依赖于目标，然而标准的在线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）仍然让actor以原始目标作为条件——当目标远离数据分布时，这一信号在几何上缺乏信息量。我们提出了方向条件化策略（DCP），这是一种完全在线的方法，将目标达成任务分解为共享一个InfoNCE表示ψ的两个组件：一个子目标评分步骤，用于在ψ_g中选择与最终目标g对齐的已访问状态z_t；以及一个方向条件化的actor，其输入为从ψ(s_t)到ψ(z_t)的单位方向d_t和幅度r_t。这两个组件联合训练，在部署时可以干净地分解（移除子目标评分，同时方向条件化保留，用g代替z_t），并允许在同一（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文基于HJB理论提出方向条件化策略（DCP），将目标达成分解为共享InfoNCE表示的子目标评分与方向条件化actor两个联合训练的组件，用几何信息更丰富的方向信号取代原始目标作为条件，从而提升在线目标条件强化学习在远距离目标上的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), which decomposes goal-reaching into jointly-trained subgoal scoring and direction-conditioned actor components sharing one InfoNCE representation, replacing raw goals with geometrically informative direction signals to improve online goal-conditioned reinforcement learning on distant goals.
